quests.instruction: Touch the body part you point up high to show something is great. It is also the one that helps your hand grip a crayon to draw, but it is NOT your fingernails!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: Hint: It helps your hand grip things tightly.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Your thumb can bend and touch each of your other fingers.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sits just below your mouth. It is also the one you rest on your hand when you are thinking hard, but it is NOT your eyelashes!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: Hint: It is right below your lips.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Your chin helps give your face its own special shape.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where you can feel your heart go thump, thump, thump. It is also the one that fills up with air when you take a big breath, but it is NOT your shoulders!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: Hint: It fills with air when you breathe in.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: A big, deep breath fills your whole chest with fresh air.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you wash every morning to feel fresh. It is NOT your eyebrows!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You see this when you look in a mirror!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Your face can make thousands of different expressions!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you nod up and down to say yes. It is also the one that holds your brain safe inside, like a helmet made of bone, but it is NOT your jaw!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Think about this: Your hat goes right on top of it.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Babies' heads grow very fast in the first year of life!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part where you might wear a cozy scarf. It is also the one that lets your head nod, shake, and turn around, but it is NOT your shoulder blade!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Think about this: You turn this to look behind you.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck has bones stacked up like a tower of blocks.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you climb up the stairs. It is also the one you use to ride a bicycle around the block, but it is NOT your calves!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Think about this: Your feet are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: The biggest muscle in your body is in the top of your leg.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that can be curly, straight, short, or long. It is also the one that keeps your head warm on a cold, snowy day, but it is NOT your jaw!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: Think about this: It grows longer if you do not cut it.
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Hair helps keep your head warm in cold weather.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you puff up big when you blow out candles. It is NOT your gums!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, one on each side of your face!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Your cheeks puff up with air when you blow a big bubble.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you click together in a fun, silly dance -- but it is not your kneecap!
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: They are below your ankles, at the back.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: Heels touch the ground first with almost every step you take.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that wiggles when you play the piano, not your armpits!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are found at the end of your hands.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Your longest finger is usually the one right in the middle!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you lift up high when you play airplane, not your chest!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You lift these up when you shrug.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Shoulders are some of the most flexible joints in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you bend to lean on the table while you eat your dinner. It is NOT your palms!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the bendy part in the middle of your arm!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: Your elbows let your arms fold in half, like a hinge on a door!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a thin bone connecting your shoulder to your chest. It is also the one found just below your neck, running side to side, but it is NOT your throat!
quests.question: Collarbone
quests.hint: Think about this: You can feel it under your skin, side to side.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Collarbone is the thin bone below your neck that connects your shoulder to your chest!
quests.funFact: The collarbone helps hold your shoulder steady and in place.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you use to carry your favorite teddy bear, not your palms!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wave these to say goodbye.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Your two arms are almost always exactly the same length!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that never stops working, even while you are asleep, not your mouth!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Your favorite song plays through these.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: No two people's ears are shaped exactly the same, just like fingerprints!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that curves up into a big happy smile. It is NOT your nose!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They curve up when you smile!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Your lips are much more sensitive to touch than most of your skin!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is the name for all the bones in your body working together. It is also the one that gives your whole body its shape and lets you stand up, but it is NOT your skull!
quests.question: Skeleton
quests.hint: Think about this: It gives your body its shape.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Skeleton is the name for all the bones in your body working together!
quests.funFact: Without your skeleton, your body would not be able to stand up at all.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that feels soft and pink inside your mouth, holding your teeth in place. It is also the one that a dentist checks along with your teeth, but it is NOT your eyebrows!
quests.question: Gums
quests.hint: Think about this: They are soft and pink, inside your mouth.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Gums are the soft pink part in your mouth that holds your teeth in place!
quests.funFact: Brushing gently helps keep your gums healthy and pink.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that lets your body bend, like your elbows and knees. It is also the one found wherever two bones meet and move together, but it is NOT your skull!
quests.question: Joints
quests.hint: Think about this: Your elbows and knees are examples of these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Joints are the bendy parts, like elbows and knees, where two bones meet!
quests.funFact: Elbows, knees, wrists, and knuckles are all examples of joints.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that moves around your mouth to help you speak clearly, not your eyelids!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You stick this out to taste snowflakes.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue is covered in tiny bumps that help you taste your food.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that wraps around your entire body, like a big, snug coat -- but it is not your skull!
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: Sunscreen protects this part from the sun.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Your skin makes new cells all the time, all by itself.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we open flat to catch raindrops falling from the sky -- but it is not your fingers!
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: You rub these together to feel warm.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: Rubbing your palms together quickly can make them feel warm.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a small, round bone at the front of your knee. It is also the one that protects your knee joint when you kneel down, but it is NOT your thighs!
quests.question: Kneecap
quests.hint: Think about this: It protects your knee when you kneel down.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Kneecap is the small round bone at the front of your knee that protects it!
quests.funFact: The kneecap protects the important joint inside your knee.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part found safely inside your head, protected by your skull, not your lungs!
quests.question: Brain
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You use it to solve puzzles and learn new things.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Brain helps you think, learn, and remember new things!
quests.funFact: Reading and playing games can help your brain grow stronger.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part we wash with soap and water before we eat, not your toenails!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wave these to say hello.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Your hands can make thousands of different shapes and signs!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a flat, triangle-shaped bone on your upper back. It is also the one that you can feel move under your skin when you shrug, but it is NOT your tummy!
quests.question: Shoulder Blade
quests.hint: Think about this: It is on your upper back, below your shoulder.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Shoulder Blade is the flat bone on your upper back that helps your arm swing!
quests.funFact: You can feel your shoulder blades move when you shrug your shoulders.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that feels scratchy if you have a cold. It is also the one you feel gently move when you swallow a sip of water, but it is NOT your back!
quests.question: Throat
quests.hint: It is inside your neck!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Throat helps you swallow food and lets your voice come out!
quests.funFact: Your throat helps you swallow food, breathe, and even make your voice!

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part that lets you bend forward, backward, and side to side, not your muscles!
quests.question: Backbone
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It goes from your neck down to your hips.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Backbone is the row of bones down your back that helps you stand tall and bend!
quests.funFact: Sitting and standing up straight helps take care of your backbone.

quests.instruction: Think carefully and touch the body part you can feel go thump, thump, thump if you rest your hand on your chest, not your skin!
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It beats faster when you run and play.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Heart beats inside your chest and pumps blood all around your body!
quests.funFact: Exercise and play help keep your heart strong and healthy.
